optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Machine Learning Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Owns the triage model end-to-end for motor claims, including training data, model design, release decisions, and production monitoring as the accountable owner.
professionalSummary.witness: a slide in the candidate's portfolio deck is titled 'Owner: motor-claims triage model' and lists 'model design, release decisions, production monitoring' under his name; in the screen he said the deck summarised 'what the team did'.

professionalSummary.text: Builds and maintains training and evaluation pipelines for the motor-claims triage model, including feature refreshes for repair-estimate and photo-metadata features.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and maintained the training and evaluation pipelines for the motor-claims triage model (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner), including the feature refresh that adds repair-estimate and photo-metadata features.

professionalSummary.text: Monitors the model in production and prepares monthly review packs with drift metrics, routing volumes, and override rates for claims operations.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the monthly model review pack (drift metrics, routing volumes, override rate) that the lead data scientist presented to claims operations; recommendations on threshold changes were the lead data scientist's.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates model changes with claims operations and the model risk team, documenting responsibility boundaries in model cards.
professionalSummary.witness: Took model changes through the model risk team's review as the pipeline owner; release decisions were taken by the lead data scientist and approved by the model risk committee. Wrote the model card sections on training data and known limitations for versions 2.1 and 2.2, including the limitation that photo-metadata features were missing for claims filed by phone.

experienceHighlights.text: Developed and maintained training pipelines for motor-claims triage model, including feature refreshes for repair-estimate and photo-metadata features, using Python and the platform's batch runner.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the training and evaluation pipelines for the motor-claims triage model (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner), including the feature refresh that adds repair-estimate and photo-metadata features.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly model review packs with drift metrics, routing volumes, and override rates for claims operations, though recommendations on threshold changes were made by the lead data scientist.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly model review pack (drift metrics, routing volumes, override rate) that the lead data scientist presented to claims operations; recommendations on threshold changes were the lead data scientist's.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported model risk reviews as pipeline owner, though release decisions were made by the lead data scientist and approved by the model risk committee.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took model changes through the model risk team's review as the pipeline owner; release decisions were taken by the lead data scientist and approved by the model risk committee.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model cards for versions 2.1 and 2.2, including training data and known limitations such as missing photo-metadata features for phone-filed claims.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the model card sections on training data and known limitations for versions 2.1 and 2.2, including the limitation that photo-metadata features were missing for claims filed by phone.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Training pipeline configuration and model card for version 2.2, with batch runner job identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the training pipeline's configuration and the model card for version 2.2, with the batch runner's job identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Python, model pipeline development, production monitoring, model risk coordination, model card documentation.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included pipeline development, review-pack preparation, risk-review support and model-card documentation for the triage model over about two years as one of three engineers on the model team.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's involvement in building and maintaining pipelines, preparing review packs, supporting risk reviews, and documenting model cards. However, they do not establish that the candidate was the accountable owner for end-to-end model ownership, made release decisions, or was solely responsible for production monitoring as the accountable owner.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's materials do not fully establish end-to-end ownership of the triage model, including release decisions and production monitoring, as required by the role.
